cards.title: Badtimes
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Runner's MU is reduced by 2 until end of turn.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Tagged-runner payoff; aktuell fehlt nur das hierarchische Pair. Optional später ein präziser Memory-/MU-Druck-Signal ergänzen.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl; Wirkung trifft Runner-MU und daraus folgende legale Programmauswahl.
recommendation.change: `strategySupportPairs` ergänzen; Taktiksignal bleibt vorerst ausreichend, aber Memory-Druck ist noch zu grob.

cards.title: Corporate Shuffle
cards.ruleText: Draw five cards, then shuffle a card stored in HQ into R&D. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Draw five plus HQ-to-R&D shuffle is deck-recycle/draw support, not central-defense support by itself.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Corp wählt eine eigene HQ-Karte; keine Runner-seitige Hidden-Info-Projektion.

cards.title: Reclamation Project
cards.ruleText: Search the archives for any number of ice cards. Show those cards to Runner, then store them in HQ. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Archives-to-HQ ICE recovery materially supports ICE density and glacier/tax rebuilds.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Corp wählt ICE aus Archives; gewählte Karten werden Runner gezeigt, danach HQ.

cards.title: Accounts Receivable
cards.ruleText: Gain 9.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl.
recommendation.change: Support-only belassen; generische Economy ist kein Strategieanker.

cards.title: Annual Reviews
cards.ruleText: Draw three cards.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl.
recommendation.change: Support-only belassen; einmaliger Draw ist kein Draw-Engine-Anker.

cards.title: Audit of Call Records
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner attempted two or more runs during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Conditional trace creates a tag source for the tag/trace punish plan.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Trace-Bidding über LegalActions; keine freie Zielwahl.

cards.title: Chance Observation
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Conditional trace creates a tag source for the tag/trace punish plan.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Trace-Bidding über LegalActions; keine freie Zielwahl.

cards.title: Closed Accounts
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Runner loses all bits.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Tagged-runner credit wipe is a tag-punish payoff, not a tag source.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl; Runner verliert Credits.
recommendation.change: Hierarchisches Payoff-Pair ergänzen; optional später präzises Credit-loss-Signal ergänzen.

cards.title: Corporate Detective Agency
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Trash up to two Resources at no cost.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Tagged-runner resource trash is a tag-punish payoff.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Bis zu zwei installierte Ressourcen; sichtbare/legale Ziele.

cards.title: Datapool by Zetatech
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Give Runner two tags.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Requires an existing tag and adds more tags; this is tag-snowball enabling, not terminal payoff.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl.
recommendation.change: Pair ergänzen; bei Umsetzung prüfen, ob zusätzlich `tag.source` aufgenommen und `tag.payoff` enger benannt werden sollte.

cards.title: Day Shift
cards.ruleText: Draw two cards and gain 1.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl.

cards.title: Edgerunner, Inc., Temps
cards.ruleText: Gain three consecutive actions, which you may use only to install cards. You are not required to take all three of these actions.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Three install-only actions are explicit Corp action-tempo support.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Folgeaktionen dürfen nur legale Install-LegalActions sein.
recommendation.change: Neuen `corp.action_tempo`-Anker und Pair ergänzen; optional Signal auf `action.corp_install_only_action` normalisieren.

cards.title: Efficiency Experts
cards.ruleText: Gain 3.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl.

cards.title: Falsified-Transactions Expert
cards.ruleText: Move up to three advancement counters from one card to another installed card that can be advanced.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Moving advancement counters can compress or salvage score windows.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Von einer Karte auf eine installierte advancebare Karte; nur legale/side-safe Ziele.

cards.title: Management Shake-Up
cards.ruleText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Three counters across installed advanceable cards directly improve scoring windows.
Because counters can overadvance, the card also enables overadvance-value lines.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Any combination of installed advanceable cards; Hidden-Info nur Corp-seitig.
recommendation.change: Pairs für Fast-Advance und Overadvance ergänzen.

cards.title: Netwatch Credit Voucher
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Give Runner 1 tag and gain 1.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Requires tagged Runner, adds another tag and minor economy; primarily tag-snowball support.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl.
recommendation.change: Pair ergänzen; `tag.payoff` später enger von `tag.source`/Snowball trennen.

cards.title: New Blood
cards.ruleText: Conceal all revealed but unrezzed ice; then rearrange your installed ice by swapping pairs of ice while Runner looks away.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Concealing and rearranging ICE is defensive glacier/tax support, with strict hidden-info handling.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Corp ordnet eigene ICE; Runner darf neue verdeckte Ordnung nicht aus KI-/Inspector-Daten ableiten.

cards.title: Night Shift
cards.ruleText: Gain 2 and draw one card.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl.

cards.title: Off-Site Backups
cards.ruleText: Bring any card from the Archives into HQ.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Corp wählt Archives-Karte; side-safe eigene Zone.
recommendation.change: Support-only belassen; kein bestehender Strategieanker für allgemeine Archives-Recovery.

cards.title: Overtime Incentives
cards.ruleText: Gain two actions.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Two extra Corp actions are a direct action-tempo payoff.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl; Folgezuege bleiben LegalActions.

cards.title: Planning Consultants
cards.ruleText: Look at the top five cards of R&D and arrange them in any order you choose.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Corp sieht/ordnet R&D top 5; keine Runner-Info.

cards.title: Power Grid Overload
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Trash X pieces of hardware, other than cybernetics.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Tagged-runner hardware trash is a tag-punish payoff.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: X Hardware außer Cybernetics; nur sichtbare/legale installierte Hardware.

cards.title: Project Consultants
cards.ruleText: Add four advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Four counters directly compress scoring windows.
Four counters can materially enable overadvance payoff lines.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Any combination of installed advanceable cards; Hidden-Info nur Corp-seitig.
recommendation.change: Pairs für Fast-Advance und Overadvance ergänzen.

cards.title: Punitive Counterstrike
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 2 meat damage.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Tagged meat damage is a damage-kill payoff.
Requires tagged Runner and converts tag state into punishment.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl; damage prevention/flatline bleibt Engine-Vertrag.

cards.title: Scorched Earth
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 4 meat damage.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Four meat damage can be a direct kill closeout.
Requires tagged Runner and converts tag state into punishment.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl; damage prevention/flatline bleibt Engine-Vertrag.
recommendation.change: Zwei hierarchische Payoff-Pairs ergänzen; `win_condition` an Damage-Pair binden.

cards.title: Silver Lining Recovery Protocol
cards.ruleText: If any agendas were stolen during Runner's last turn, gain bits equal to three times the number of advancement counters those agendas had.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl.

cards.title: Systematic Layoffs
cards.ruleText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Two counters improve score windows.
Can enable overadvance payoff lines.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Any combination of installed advanceable cards.
recommendation.change: Pairs für Fast-Advance und Overadvance ergänzen.

cards.title: Team Restructuring
cards.ruleText: Add one advancement counter to each of up to two installed cards that can be advanced.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Distributed advancement counters support score-window compression.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Bis zu zwei installierte advancebare Karten.

cards.title: Trojan Horse
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner stole any agendas during his or her last turn. Give Runner a tag.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Retaliatory tag source after stolen agenda supports tag/trace punish plans.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl.

cards.title: Urban Renewal
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 5 meat damage.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Five meat damage is a direct kill closeout.
Requires tagged Runner and converts tag state into punishment.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl; damage prevention/flatline bleibt Engine-Vertrag.
recommendation.change: Zwei hierarchische Payoff-Pairs ergänzen; `win_condition` an Damage-Pair binden.

cards.title: Corporate Guard(R) Temps
cards.ruleText: Pay two times [X] when you play Corporate Guard(R) Temps, to gain an action during each of your next X turns. Forfeit the next [X] you gain.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Future extra actions create a temporary action-tempo engine with forfeit drawback.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: X wird beim Spielen bezahlt; Folgeaktionen/Forfeit bleiben LegalAction-/Engine-Vertrag.

cards.title: Credit Consolidation
cards.ruleText: Gain [15].

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl.

cards.title: Data Sifters
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner trashed any nodes during his or her last turn. Give Runner a tag.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Retaliatory tag source after node trash supports tag/trace punish.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: keine Zielwahl.

cards.title: Emergency Rig
cards.ruleText: Rez a piece of ice, at no cost. Put X Kludge counters on that piece of ice; X cannot be 0. At the start of each of your turns, remove a Kludge counter. Trash that piece of ice when the last Kludge counter is removed from it.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Free temporary rez supports glacier/tax windows but carries expiry liability.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Wähle installierte ICE; Rez-/Counter-/Trash-Folge ist Engine-Vertrag.
recommendation.change: Hierarchisches Pair ergänzen; Rolle von losem `tax_tool` auf `enabler` präzisieren.

cards.title: Manhunt
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during his or her last turn. Trace 6-If trace is successful, give Runner one tag for each point by which your trace exceeded his or her link.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Trace can create one or more tags, making it a strong tag/trace punish enabler.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Trace-Bidding über LegalActions.

cards.title: Rent-to-Own Contract
cards.ruleText: Rez a piece of ice, at no cost. Put on that ice a number of Term counters equal to its rez cost. At the start of each of your turns, if you have at least [2], lose [2] and remove one of these Term counters; otherwise, put a Term counter on that piece of ice.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Free rez with term counters supports ICE-tax/glacier setup, with recurring payment liability.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Wähle installierte ICE; Term-Counter und Zahlung/Verlängerung bleiben Engine-Vertrag.

cards.title: Schlaghund Pointers
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner has attempted a run this game. Trace 3-If trace is successful, give Runner a tag. Pay [1], in addition to the normal cost, for each point of trace above 0.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Paid trace creates a tag source for tag/trace punish.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Trace-Bidding/Kosten über LegalActions.

cards.title: Underworld Mole
cards.ruleText: Play only if Runner installed any resources during his or her last turn. Trace 4-If trace is successful, trash a resource Runner installed during his or her last turn and give Runner a tag.

strategySupportPairs.rationale: Trace can trash the newly installed resource and give a tag; this is both tag source and resource punish payoff.

recommendation.targetOrConstraints: Nur Ressourcen, die Runner letzte Runde installierte; Trace und Zielwahl legal/side-safe.
